decals.name: Each row is that blueprint with a different material. The catalogue uses the material name.
decals.default_note: UDecalComponent's constructor sets DecalSize to 128, 256, 256 cm, and that vector is the box extent around the pivot (depth, width, height). The blueprint can override it. No decal mesh bounds exist, so every decal row stays bounds_estimated.
